sources.excerpt: Suzz Wah-Wah Published on July 26, 2005 Carlsbro "Alu" series fuzz-wah foot-controlled treadle early review early review Information The Carlsbro Wah Suzz is a combination unit integrating a traditional wah pedal with the Suzz fuzz circuit. Housed in a single enclosure with an expression treadle, the Wah Suzz enables both tonal filtering and distortion from one unified platform. The pedal includes two rotary controls: Gain , which governs the fuzz saturation level, and Sustain , which determines the length and compression of the distorted signal. The wah section operates via the rocker treadle, allowing real-time manipulation of the filter sweep. The two effects are internally connected, and while both are always in-line, their interaction is tailored for expressive, lead-oriented applications. Controls Gain (fuzz section) Sustain (fuzz section) Expression treadle (wah control) Connections Input jack Output jack Technical Specifications Analog fuzz and wah circuits Powered by 9V battery Combined control surface and enclosure Highlights Integrated wah and fuzz effects in one unit Real-time wah control via treadle Saturated fuzz with adjustable gain and sustain Compact form factor for multifunction use - **Archive parent:** Suzz Wah-Wah - **Builder:** Carlsbro - **Catalog type:** Fuzz - **Identity:** Carlsbro's Suzz Wah-Wah.
